fact: The Ebolowa workshop of 3-14 November 2025 gave technical validation to the draft e-Gov bill on public information access and administrative digital transformation, which aims to standardise digital practice, with experts' recommendations covering interoperability; the text was then ready for ministerial finalisation (article published 2026-01-21).

PATNuC describes the e-Gov reform, examined at the Ebolowa 2025 workshop, as providing that administrations must make their information systems compatible, with GovTech Cameroun setting security and interoperability norms; it does not state that the law has been adopted (published 2025-11-20, no other date given).
